name: XWA Saturday Night Debut Card, 15 November 1997

date.source: The card's own dateline; the subject line's own switch from (BWF) to (XWA) is the rename receipt.

notes: The fed's first card under the XWA name; announce desk turns over from Jerry "Iceman" Richards and Lord Williams III to Brett Rose and Jim Burns.

name: XWA Saturday Night, 6 December 1997

date.source: The card's own dateline; recovered from the post's own quoted-printable MIME body (msg_id nwmhq10-ZwcJ, attachment SatNight12697.txt).

matches.finish: AJ Simon defeated AzteK by disqualification after AzteK's ally The GodFather ran in and attacked Simon while Simon had AzteK trapped in a submission hold ("The Simon").

matches.stipulation: Stable leaders' collision: MAFIA (The GodFather) vs. DMW (The Crippler).
matches.finish: The GodFather pinned The Crippler after a Horse's Head superplex off the top rope.

appearances.note: Also called out $$$KASH$$$ post-match, who signed a MAFIA contract before attacking him with a hidden baseball bat -- a DMW heel turn for KASH.

notes: Referee Jimmy Jameson (unminted, not recorded in appearances) worked both matches; co-announcer Rich Stevenson and ring announcer James Stewart also appear this episode but are not yet minted characters in this wing's shard.

name: XWA Tuesday Night Warfare, 9 December 1997

date.source: The card's own dateline; recovered from the post's own quoted-printable MIME body (msg_id xJe-cIplqmYJ, attachment TuesNight12997.txt).

matches.stipulation: Both men are billed as entrants in the upcoming XWA United States Championship tournament.
matches.finish: Gene Hoffman defeated Riot with a flying leg drop off the top rope.

The GodFather -- advertised as too injured to compete, with Sammy "The Bull" Gravano (unminted) filling in -- appeared himself and pinned Art Middleton after a Horse's Head superplex off the turnbuckle.

$$$KASH$$$ reversed a Deranged Stu rollup for the pin. Post-match, The GodFather's MAFIA group (with Sammy "The Bull" Gravano and Riot, both unminted, and DeathHead Distruct) confronted KASH at ringside under Commissioner Knapik's (unminted) watch, then DMW (AJ Simon, The Crippler, Dustin Buchanon and Gene Hoffman, the latter turning on MAFIA) ran in for a post-match brawl.

appearances.note: Appears with MAFIA at ringside during the main event brawl; billed here as Distruct.
Joins DMW's post-match run-in on MAFIA; billed as future opponent in the U.S. tournament earlier in the broadcast.

notes: Commissioner Jon Knapik (in-fiction Commissioner Knapik; unminted character) appears diegetically at the announce desk to keep order between MAFIA and $$$KASH$$$. Co-announcer Rich Stevenson also appears but is not yet a minted character in this wing's shard. Riot, Sammy "The Bull" Gravano, Dustin Buchanon, AJ Simon and Dr. Eugene Dike also appear but are not yet minted.
